svg.aria-label: 20-step timeline showing rollout and training overlap for agentic and distributed
svg.text: Training pipeline: matched 2+2 TPU and 8-trajectory microbatches
Each thin stripe is one measured step (1–20), aligned to step start; top = step 1, bottom = step 20.
Dashed line: mean time of last trajectory completion. Rollout bar spans first start to last completion.
Stage bars are completed host spans, including device waits. Orange bars under blue show actual overlap.
Overlap means training-call time clipped to the rollout collection window, not chip utilization.
